abilities.title_zh: 闪避——闹翻天也可以利用他的传送进行防御，躲避危险。
abilities.title_en: Cut and Run - Skywarp can use his teleportation defensively too, dodging away from danger.
abilities.desc_zh:
受到攻击时：如果闹天有传送冲锋，{{var_14}} 几率闪避特殊技 1 或特殊技 2 的最后一击。这会消耗传送冲锋。

+{{var_15}} 每级
abilities.desc_en:
Cut and Run - Skywarp can use his teleportation defensively too, dodging away from danger.
When Attacked: If Skywarp has a Teleport Charge, {{var_14}} chance to dodge the last hit of a Special Attack 1 or Special Attack 2. This expends a Teleport Charge.
+{{var_15}} per level

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_24}}~{{var_25}} 伤害和 {{var_26}}~{{var_27}} 所有霸天虎远程攻击的穿甲。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_24}}~{{var_25}} Damage and {{var_26}}~{{var_27}} Armor Piercing for all Decepticon Ranged Attacks.

abilities.desc_zh: {{var_30}}~{{var_31}} 增加对拆除机器人的攻击评级。仅当团队中的所有机器人都具有此协同羁绊时，冲击波才能受益于此奖励
abilities.desc_en: {{var_30}}~{{var_31}} increase to Attack Rating against Demolition Bots. Shockwave only benefits from this bonus if all Bots on the team have this Synergy

abilities.desc_zh: {{var_32}}~{{var_33}} 战斗开始时对{{var_34}}进行远程回避。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_32}}~{{var_33}} Ranged evade for {{var_34}} at the start of combat.

abilities.desc_zh: 作为领导的灯塔，所有较低级别的队友都获得+{{var_35}}功率率。
abilities.desc_en: Acting as a beacon of leadership, all lower tier teammates gain +{{var_35}} Power Rate.

abilities.desc_zh:
每8秒得到一个传送充能，最大叠加3层  // 图标显示的方式参考暗天陨的充能
如果闹翻天受到暴击，有25%的概率丢失一个传送充能，受到战士系暴击时概率为50%
成功闪避一次特殊攻击，得到一个传送充能  // 多段连击的特殊攻击也只算一次

在拥有传送充能时，特殊攻击1和2会变为传送攻击  // 技能期间显示橙色图标，传送攻击会改变特殊技的动作，需要在asset中找到专属动作

传送攻击的暴击率增加27%
传送攻击不可防御
传送攻击有50%的概率施加8秒的能量锁定
传送攻击100%概率净化所有震击减益
获得9秒能量燃烧状态，普通远程和远程重击命中或被防时立即扣除对手最大能量的8%   //黄图标
abilities.desc_en: Short Circuit - His short fuse and their short circuit.

abilities.desc_zh: 最后一击命中时100%概率触发修复阻止，阻止对方所有回血能力，持续12秒
abilities.desc_en: If the opponent reaches zero Power as a result of this Power Burn, the strength of their Power Gain Buffs is reduced by {{var_12}} for the rest of the fight.

abilities.desc_zh: 100%的概率窃取对手最大能量的50% //立即结算，我方加能量，对方减能量，红色图标出现在对方侧，一闪而过
如果能量窃取之后对方能量减为0，则得到一个永久能量涌动增益，提升能量功率15%，只能叠加一层。
临时增加攻击命中时触发暴击的几率。
abilities.desc_en: Temporarily increases the chance of scoring critical hits.

abilities.desc_zh: 立即扣减对手的能量槽。
abilities.desc_en: Instantly burns the opponent's power gauge.

abilities.desc_zh: 盗取对手当前储存的能量槽，并将其转移给自己。
abilities.desc_en: Steals stored power from the opponent and transfers it to the user.

abilities.desc_zh: 临时阻止目标回复生命值，全面抑制回血与再生效果。
abilities.desc_en: Temporarily prevents the target from regaining health, shutting down all healing.
